brands.name: Oatly
brands.note: 100% plant-based oat drink brand. All products are vegan.

brands.name: Alpro
brands.note: Mostly plant-based (soy, oat, almond). Some products may contain honey — check label.

brands.name: Califia Farms
brands.note: Plant-based milks and creamers. Most products are vegan; check individual items.

brands.name: Silk
brands.note: Plant-based milk brand. Most products are vegan; verify individual flavored variants.

brands.name: Ripple
brands.note: Pea protein-based milk and products. Fully plant-based.

brands.name: Minor Figures
brands.note: Specialty oat milk brand, popular in coffee shops. Fully vegan.

brands.name: Beyond Meat
brands.note: Plant-based meat brand. All products are vegan.

brands.name: Impossible Foods
brands.note: Most products are vegan. Some restaurant preparations may add non-vegan toppings — check context.

brands.name: Quorn
brands.note: Many Quorn products contain egg white or milk. Look specifically for their 'Vegan' labeled range.

brands.name: Tofurky
brands.note: Most Tofurky products are vegan. Verify any deli products that may share facility with non-vegan items.

brands.name: Lightlife
brands.note: Plant-based meats. Most products are vegan; check Smart Dogs variants.

brands.name: MorningStar Farms
brands.note: Many MorningStar products contain egg whites or dairy. Look for the explicit 'Vegan' label on packaging.

brands.name: Gardein
brands.note: Most Gardein products are vegan; some contain egg whites. Always check the label.

brands.name: OmniPork
brands.note: Asia-focused plant-based meat brand. All products are vegan.

brands.name: THIS
brands.note: UK-based plant-based meat brand. All products are vegan.

brands.name: Violife
brands.note: 100% vegan cheese brand. No dairy, no nuts, no soy.

brands.name: Daiya
brands.note: Fully plant-based cheese and dairy-free products.

brands.name: Miyoko's Creamery
brands.note: Artisan plant-based cheese and butter. Fully vegan.

brands.name: JUST Egg
brands.note: Mung bean-based egg substitute. Fully plant-based.

brands.name: Oreo
brands.note: Classic Oreos have vegan ingredients but are made in facilities handling dairy. Most vegans consider the original variety acceptable. Check flavored variants individually.

brands.name: Hippeas
brands.note: Chickpea puffs brand. All products are certified vegan.

brands.name: Hu Kitchen
brands.note: Paleo-friendly chocolate brand. All products are dairy-free and vegan.

brands.name: Enjoy Life
brands.note: Allergen-free brand. All products are vegan and free from top 14 allergens.

brands.name: Justin's
brands.note: Nut butters and chocolate confections. Most are vegan; milk chocolate varieties are not.

brands.name: Larabar
brands.note: Date-based bars. Most varieties are vegan; check flavors with chocolate coating.

brands.name: Pringles
brands.note: Original and some flavors are vegan. Many flavors contain dairy (sour cream, cheese). Always check the specific flavor label.

brands.name: Amy's Kitchen
brands.note: Organic brand with both vegetarian and vegan options. Not all products are vegan — look for the 'Vegan' label on pack.

brands.name: Follow Your Heart
brands.note: Maker of Vegenaise. Fully vegan dressings and dairy-free products.

brands.name: Kite Hill
brands.note: Almond-based cheese, yogurt, and cream cheese. Fully plant-based.

brands.name: Sir Kensington's
brands.note: Condiment brand with vegan and non-vegan options. Their Fabanaise and vegan mayo range are vegan; classic mayo contains eggs.

brands.name: e.l.f. Cosmetics
brands.note: 100% vegan and cruelty-free cosmetics brand.

brands.name: Urban Decay
brands.note: All Urban Decay products are vegan and cruelty-free.

brands.name: The Body Shop
brands.note: Cruelty-free brand but not all products are vegan (some contain beeswax or lanolin). Look for the 'V' vegan symbol on the pack.

brands.name: Herbivore Botanicals
brands.note: Clean beauty brand. All products are vegan, cruelty-free, and made with natural ingredients.

brands.name: Pacifica Beauty
brands.note: 100% vegan and cruelty-free beauty brand.

brands.name: Lush
brands.note: Fresh handmade cosmetics. Many products are vegan (marked with a V), but some contain honey, beeswax, or lanolin.

brands.name: Vitasoy
brands.note: Popular soy milk brand across Asia. Most products are plant-based; some contain honey. Common in Thailand, Hong Kong, and Australia.

brands.name: V-Whole
brands.note: Thai vegan brand specialising in plant-based meats. All products are vegan.

brands.name: Let's Plant Meat
brands.note: Thai plant-based meat brand available in 80+ supermarkets. All products are vegan.

brands.name: Innocent
brands.note: Smoothies and juices. Most are vegan; some vitamin-enriched products use lanolin-derived vitamin D3.

brands.name: Tropicana
brands.note: Juices are generally vegan but some 'heart healthy' lines contain omega-3 from fish oil. Always check the label.

brands.name: Nudie
brands.note: UK plant-based snack brand. All products are vegan.

brands.name: Oumph!
brands.note: Swedish soy-based meat alternative brand. All products are vegan.

brands.name: Fry's Family Foods
brands.note: South African brand popular in Australia. 100% plant-based, non-GMO, and halal-certified. Widely available in Woolworths and Coles.

brands.name: Botanical Cuisine
brands.note: Melbourne-based brand. Certified organic, raw, vegan, and gluten-free. Specialises in cashew and macadamia-based cheeses and cultured butter.

brands.name: Funky Fields
brands.note: Australian plant-based brand by Danish innovator Naturli' Foods. Offers vegan butter spreads and plant-based mince. All products are 100% plant-based.

brands.name: INIKA Organic
brands.note: Australian cosmetics brand. World's first Plastic Neutral certified makeup brand. 100% vegan, certified organic, and cruelty-free.

brands.name: RAWW Cosmetics
brands.note: Australian-made cosmetics brand, certified vegan and cruelty-free. Uses superfood-inspired ingredients.

brands.name: SCOUT Cosmetics
brands.note: 100% vegan, cruelty-free Australian cosmetics brand. COSMOS and Certified Organic certified.

brands.name: Lust Minerals
brands.note: Australian mineral-based makeup brand. 100% vegan, cruelty-free, and made in Australia.

brands.name: Noshu
brands.note: Australian low-sugar snack brand. Many products are vegan; check individual items as some contain dairy or eggs.

brands.name: Vegie Delights
brands.note: Australian vegetarian brand by Sanitarium. Some products are vegan, others contain egg or dairy. Look for the 'V' vegan icon on packaging.

brands.name: Pana Chocolate
brands.note: Melbourne-based organic vegan chocolate brand. All products are certified organic and vegan.

brands.name: Loving Earth
brands.note: Melbourne-based sustainable food brand. All products are fully vegan and certified organic.

brands.name: Buona Vita
brands.note: Australian plant-based pasta and gnocchi brand. All products are certified vegan.

brands.name: Green Common
brands.note: Hong Kong's pioneering plant-based grocery and restaurant brand. Parent company of OmniFoods. All retail products are 100% plant-based.

brands.name: Next Meats
brands.note: Japanese plant-based meat company. Produces vegan equivalents of yakiniku barbecue meats, gyudon, and egg substitutes. Non-GMO soy protein base.

brands.name: Starfield
brands.note: Leading Chinese plant protein brand offering vegan bacon, dairy-free cheese, and a wide range of plant-based products.

brands.name: Bangkok Bites
brands.note: Thai snack brand (rebranded from Goodness Plant) offering vegan protein chips and jerky in authentic Thai flavours like Tom Yum and Pad Thai.

brands.name: Greendot
brands.note: Singapore-based 100% plant-based fast-food chain and food brand. All menu items and retail products are vegan.

brands.name: Vegreen
brands.note: South Korean plant-based meat brand. All products are vegan and tailored to Korean culinary traditions.

brands.name: TheVeganKind
brands.note: UK and Asia-distributed vegan subscription box brand. Curates fully vegan snack and lifestyle products.

brands.name: Alpha Foods
brands.note: US brand with strong distribution in Southeast Asia. All products are certified vegan.

brands.name: Wicked Kitchen
brands.note: Plant-based ready meal and ingredients brand. Available in Australia, SE Asia, and globally. All products are vegan.

brands.name: Harvest Gourmet
brands.note: Nestlé's plant-based brand for Asia and Australia. All products in the Harvest Gourmet line are 100% plant-based.

brands.name: OMISOM
brands.note: Japanese upcycled soy vegan brand known for zero-waste ingredients. All products are fully vegan.

brands.name: Soylent
brands.note: Complete nutrition plant-based meal replacement drinks and bars. All products are vegan.

brands.name: Ceres Organics
brands.note: New Zealand organic brand, popular in Australia and Southeast Asia. Most products are vegan; check dairy-containing lines.

brands.name: Sweet William
brands.note: Australian chocolate brand, 20+ years old. All products are vegan-friendly with no animal or animal-derived ingredients, made in a dedicated dairy-free, gluten-free, nut-free facility. Available in Thailand. Not formally Vegan Society certified but brand explicitly confirms all products are vegan.

brands.name: Swees Cheese
brands.note: Thai vegan cheese brand — operators of Thailand's first vegan cheese factory. Makes Swiss-style, cheddar, mozzarella, and cream cheese from organic soybeans. Not formally third-party certified but fully plant-based by design.

brands.name: Natural Efe
brands.note: Phuket-based organic and macrobiotic vegan health food store and cafe. Sells and produces vegan products including plant-based cheeses. Not a certified vegan brand — products are intended to be vegan but always verify individual items.

brands.name: Nature's Charm
brands.note: Thai brand founded by sisters from a coconut milk manufacturing family. Specialises in coconut-based dairy alternatives: condensed coconut milk, coconut whipping cream, jackfruit products, and vegan sauces. Fully plant-based and cruelty-free by design. Not formally third-party certified but widely regarded as vegan. Available internationally.

brands.name: Mae Pranom
brands.note: Traditional Thai condiment brand. Has vegetarian and vegan variants including a vegan chili paste and plant-based crispy chili with pea protein. Many standard products contain shrimp paste — only buy the green-label 'Vegetarian' variants.

brands.name: HappyLyfe
brands.note: Thai brand making handcrafted vegan truffles and confections from organic ingredients. Fully plant-based by design. Not formally certified.

brands.name: Perfect Earth Foods
brands.note: Thai certified organic brand. Offers vegan rice pasta, instant rice noodles, and rice crackers. All products are plant-based and certified organic.

brands.name: Meat Avatar
brands.note: Thai plant-based meat startup making meat alternatives for Southeast Asian cuisine. All products are fully plant-based. Not formally certified.

brands.name: Plantae
brands.note: Thai high-protein plant-based food brand. All products are vegan and designed for health-conscious consumers. Not formally certified.

brands.name: Ecover
brands.note: Belgian ecological cleaning brand, widely available in Europe and Asia. No animal-derived ingredients and Leaping Bunny cruelty-free certified. Brand confirms no animal by-products. No formal Vegan Society cert.

brands.name: Method
brands.note: 100% vegan and triple cruelty-free certified cleaning brand. All products are plant-derived with no animal ingredients. Brand explicitly confirms all products are vegan. No formal third-party vegan cert.

brands.name: SOGANICS
brands.note: 100% vegan, plant-based household cleaning brand. Leaping Bunny certified since 2020. All ingredients are plant-based with no animal testing.

brands.name: Seventh Generation
brands.note: US plant-based household cleaning brand, available globally including Asia. All products are vegan and cruelty-free, using plant-derived and mineral-based ingredients.

brands.name: Attitude Living
brands.note: Canadian eco-cleaning and personal care brand. All household products are vegan, EWG Verified, and Leaping Bunny certified. Also B Corp certified.

brands.name: Puracy
brands.note: Plant-based cleaning and personal care brand. All products are 100% vegan and cruelty-free. Popular in Asia via online retail.

brands.name: Kinn Living
brands.note: UK eco-cleaning brand. All products are Vegan Society certified and Leaping Bunny cruelty-free. Uses refillable and concentrated formats.

brands.name: Bio-D
brands.note: UK hypoallergenic cleaning brand. All products are Vegan Society certified and completely free from animal-derived ingredients.
